Definition: from G5185; to make blind, i.e. (figuratively) to obscure:--blind.
BiblicalUsage: The word typhlóō carries the sense of to blind, to make blind. In John 12:40, He hath blinded their eyes, and it appears again in 2 Corinthians 4:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the blinding of John and of Corinthians is a judgment I must fear, and only God opens blind eyes.
